latest_release.name: V3.18.0 Haven
latest_release.body:
Pake V3.18.0

Turn any webpage into a desktop app with one command.

### Changelog 1. Downloads on Windows now show the native WebView2 download panel with progress, and same-site downloads go through it too. 2. Dragging files onto a page to upload them now always works. `--enable-drag-drop` used to block those drops, and on Windows it also broke drag and drop inside pages; it is now accepted but ignored, so existing build commands keep working. 3. Downloaded files keep their real names, so a link to `Annual Report.pdf` or `报告.pdf` is no longer saved as `Annual%20Report.pdf` or `%E6%8A%A5%E5%91%8A.pdf`. 4. The tray menu follows the system language, with Simplified and Traditional Chinese labels. 5. After a failed build on Windows, the next build starts normally instead of stopping on a leftover compilation cache lock. 6. Apps built without `--icon` get the new flat mother-and-baby icon, the same one Pake for Mac and Windows uses. 7. Dependencies are updated for published RustSec and npm security advisories. 8. The docs now live at [pake.run](https://pake.run), with a step-by-step getting started tutorial and pages for shortcuts, scripts and AI agents. ### 更新日志 1. Windows 上下载文件会显示 WebView2 自带的下载面板和进度，同一网站内的下载也走这个面板。 2. 把文件拖到网页上上传现在都能正常用了，以前加了 `--enable-drag-drop` 反而会拦下这些文件，Windows 上网页里的拖拽也会失效，这个参数现在保留但不再生效，已有的打包命令照常能用。 3. 下载的文件保留原来的名字，`Annual Report.pdf` 或 `报告.pdf` 这样的链接不会再存成 `Annual%20Report.pdf`、`%E6%8A%A5%E5%91%8A.pdf`。 4. 托盘菜单跟随系统语言，中文系统上显示简体或繁体中文。 5. Windows 上构建失败后，下一次构建能正常开始，不会再被残留的编译缓存锁挡住。 6. 没有指定 `--icon` 时，应用默认用新的扁平母婴图标，和 Pake 桌面版用的是同一个。 7. 依赖已按公开的 RustSec 和 npm 安全公告更新。 8. 文档搬到了 [pake.run](https://pake.run)，新增一步步的入门教程，以及快捷键、脚本和 AI Agent 相关的页面。 Special thanks to @WavesMan, @NgoQuocViet2001, and @jakero for the pull requests behind this release. If Pake helps you, please consider giving it a star and recommending it to your friends. > https://github.com/tw93/Pake

detail.readme:
Pake

Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command. Supports macOS, Windows and Linux. Free open-source CLI, plus a desktop app.

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français

> This repo is the free open-source Pake CLI, and everything below stays free. Prefer a graphical app? The Pake desktop app is a separate download from [pake.run](https://pake.run/), its only official site. It makes apps from a ready-made gallery or any URL without Node.js or Rust, with settings, updates and separate apps for other accounts in one window. `pnpm install -g pake-cli` installs the CLI only. ## Features - **Lightweight**: Installers are typically under 10 MB, nearly 20 times smaller than Electron packages, a lighter alternative to Nativefier and other Electron wrappers - **Fast**: Built with Rust Tauri on the system WebView instead of a bundled Chromium, so each app carries no browser engine of its own - **Easy to use**: One-command packaging via CLI or online building, no complex configuration needed - **Feature-rich**: Supports shortcuts, immersive windows, drag & drop, style customization, ad removal ## Getting Started - **Beginners**: Make apps without a command line in the [Pake desktop app](https://pake.run/), download ready-made [Popular Packages](#popular-packages) or use [Online Building](docs/github-actions-usage.md) with no environment setup required - **Developers**: Install [CLI Tool](docs/cli-usage.md) for one-command packaging of any website with customizable icons, window settings, and more - **Advanced Users**: Clone the project locally for [Custom Development](#development), or check [Advanced Usage](docs/advanced-usage.md) for style customization and feature enhancement - **Troubleshooting**: Check [FAQ](docs/faq.md) for common issues and solutions ## Popular Packages
WeRead Mac Windows Linux X Mac Windows Linux
Grok Mac Windows Linux DeepSeek Mac Windows Linux
ChatGPT Mac Windows Linux Gemini Mac Windows Linux
YouTube Music Mac Windows Linux YouTube Mac Windows Linux
LiZhi Mac Windows Linux ProgramMusic Mac Windows Linux
Excalidraw Mac Windows Linux XiaoHongShu Mac Windows Linux
Notion Mac Windows Linux Flomo Mac Windows Linux
More apps are on the [Releases](https://github.com/tw93/Pake/releases) page.
Keyboard shortcuts
| Mac | Windows/Linux | Function | | --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | | ⌘ + [ | Ctrl + [ | Return to the previous page | | ⌘ + ] | Ctrl + ] | Go to the next page | | ⌘ + ↑ | Ctrl + ↑ | Auto scroll to top of page | | ⌘ + ↓ | Ctrl + ↓ | Auto scroll to bottom of page | | ⌘ + R | Ctrl + R | Refresh page | | ⌘ + W | Ctrl + W | Hide window, not quit | | ⌘ + - | Ctrl + - | Zoom out | | ⌘ + = | Ctrl + = | Zoom in | | ⌘ + 0 | Ctrl + 0 | Reset zoom | | ⌘ + L | Ctrl + L | Copy current page URL | | ⌘ + ⇧ + ⌥ + V | Ctrl + Shift + V | Paste and match style | | ⌘ + ⇧ + H | Ctrl + Shift + H | Go to home page | | ⌘ + ⌥ + I | Ctrl + Shift + I | Toggle developer tools (debug only) | | ⌘ + ⇧ + ⌫ | Ctrl + Shift + Del | Clear cache and restart | | ⌃ + ⌘ + F | F11 | Toggle native window fullscreen | Double-click the title bar to toggle fullscreen. On Windows and Linux, `--hide-window-decorations` gives a frameless window with a top drag region. On Mac, swipe to go back or forward and drag the title bar to move the window, and the menu bar has navigation, zoom and window controls.
## Command-Line Packaging ![Pake](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/static/main/pake/pake1.gif) ```bash # Install Pake CLI pnpm install -g pake-cli # Basic usage, fetches the website icon automatically pake https://github.com --name GitHub # Advanced usage, custom options pake https://weekly.tw93.fun --name Weekly --icon https://cdn.tw93.fun/pake/weekly.icns --width 1200 --height 800 --hide-title-bar ``` The first build sets up the environment and takes a while, later builds are fast. See the [CLI Usage Guide](docs/cli-usage.md) for every option, or try [GitHub Actions Online Building](docs/github-actions-usage.md) if you'd rather skip the command line. Using Pake from a script or AI agent? Pass `--json` for machine-readable results, describe apps declaratively with `--config app.json` ([schema](schema/pake.schema.json)), and package local build output directly with `pake ./dist --name MyTool`. See [llms.txt](llms.txt) for the full agent contract. The official skill installs like this: ```text # Claude Code /plugin marketplace add tw93/Pake /plugin install pake@pake # Codex codex plugin marketplace add tw93/Pake codex plugin add pake@pake ``` Copy this to your AI agent to get started: ```text Use Pake (npm i -g pake-cli) to package webpages as desktop apps. Read https://unpkg.com/pake-cli@latest/llms.txt first; always run pake with --json and parse stdout as a single JSON object. Package into an app named . ``` ## Development Requires Rust `>=1.85` and Node `>=22` (recommended LTS; `>=20.9` also works), see the [Tauri documentation](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/) for setup. If you are new to this toolchain, the CLI is the easier path. ```bash # Install dependencies pnpm i # Local development, right-click to open the debug tools pnpm run dev # Build application pnpm run build ``` For style customization, feature enhancement, container communication and other advanced features, see [Advanced Usage Documentation](docs/advanced-usage.md). ## Contributors Pake wouldn't be possible without these incredible contributors. ## Support - Getting the [Pake desktop app](https://pake.run/) is the most direct way to support Pake's development - If Pake helped you, give it a star, [share it](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https://github.com/tw93/Pake&text=Pake%20-%20Turn%20any%20webpage%20into%20a%20desktop%20app%20with%20one%20command.%20Nearly%2020x%20smaller%20than%20Electron%20packages,%20supports%20macOS%20Windows%20Linux), or open an issue or PR, including sites that would make good desktop apps - I have two cats, TangYuan and Coke, and if Pake makes your life a little easier, feel free to treat them to canned food These lovely people already did ## License Pake is open source under GPL-3.0, see [LICENSE](./LICENSE) and [Pake Output Exception](./LICENSE-EXCEPTION); apps you build with Pake are entirely yours to use and distribute. If you fork Pake into your own product, to avoid confusion please give it a different name and credit Pake as the source. Pake CLI stays open source for the long run.
detail.readme_zh:
Pake

一条命令把任意网页打包成轻量的桌面应用，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，免费开源命令行，另有桌面版

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français

> 这个仓库是免费开源的 Pake CLI，下面的内容都一直免费。喜欢图形界面的话，Pake 桌面版要从唯一的官网 [pake.run](https://pake.run/zh) 单独下载。桌面版不用装 Node.js 和 Rust，从精选里选一个或者粘贴网址就能做好应用，改设置、更新应用和给不同账号做独立应用都在同一个窗口里。`pnpm install -g pake-cli` 只会安装命令行工具。 ## 特性 - **体积小巧**：安装包通常小于 10 MB，比 Electron 应用小近 20 倍，是 Nativefier 这类 Electron 套壳工具更轻的替代 - **性能优异**：基于 Rust Tauri，用系统自带的 WebView 而不是打包一份 Chromium，应用里不用再带一份浏览器引擎 - **使用简单**：命令行一键打包，或在线构建，无需复杂配置 - **功能丰富**：支持快捷键透传、沉浸式窗口、拖拽、样式定制、去广告 ## 快速开始 - **新手用户**：用 [Pake 桌面版](https://pake.run/zh) 不碰命令行就能做应用，也可以直接下载现成的 [常用包](#常用包下载)，或通过 [在线构建](docs/github-actions-usage_CN.md) 无需环境配置即可打包 - **开发者**：安装 [CLI 工具](docs/cli-usage_CN.md) 后一行命令打包任意网站，支持自定义图标、窗口等参数 - **高级用户**：本地克隆项目进行 [定制开发](#定制开发)，或查看 [高级用法](docs/advanced-usage_CN.md) 实现样式定制、功能增强 - **遇到问题**：查看 [常见问题](docs/faq_CN.md) 排查故障与使用疑问 ## 常用包下载
WeRead Mac Windows Linux X Mac Windows Linux
Grok Mac Windows Linux DeepSeek Mac Windows Linux
ChatGPT Mac Windows Linux Gemini Mac Windows Linux
YouTube Music Mac Windows Linux YouTube Mac Windows Linux
LiZhi Mac Windows Linux ProgramMusic Mac Windows Linux
Excalidraw Mac Windows Linux XiaoHongShu Mac Windows Linux
Notion Mac Windows Linux Flomo Mac Windows Linux
更多应用可以去 [Releases](https://github.com/tw93/Pake/releases) 下载。
快捷键说明
| Mac | Windows/Linux | 功能 | | --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | | ⌘ + [ | Ctrl + [ | 返回上一个页面 | | ⌘ + ] | Ctrl + ] | 前进到下一个页面 | | ⌘ + ↑ | Ctrl + ↑ | 自动滚动到页面顶部 | | ⌘ + ↓ | Ctrl + ↓ | 自动滚动到页面底部 | | ⌘ + R | Ctrl + R | 刷新页面 | | ⌘ + W | Ctrl + W | 隐藏窗口（非退出） | | ⌘ + - | Ctrl + - | 缩小页面 | | ⌘ + = | Ctrl + = | 放大页面 | | ⌘ + 0 | Ctrl + 0 | 重置页面缩放 | | ⌘ + L | Ctrl + L | 复制当前页面网址 | | ⌘ + ⇧ + ⌥ + V | Ctrl + Shift + V | 粘贴并匹配样式 | | ⌘ + ⇧ + H | Ctrl + Shift + H | 回到首页 | | ⌘ + ⌥ + I | Ctrl + Shift + I | 开启调试（仅开发版） | | ⌘ + ⇧ + ⌫ | Ctrl + Shift + Del | 清除缓存并重启 | | ⌃ + ⌘ + F | F11 | 切换原生全屏 | 双击标题栏可以切换全屏，Windows 和 Linux 加上 `--hide-window-decorations` 会得到带顶部拖拽区域的无边框窗口，Mac 支持手势滑动返回与前进，也可以拖动标题栏移动窗口，菜单栏里也有导航、缩放和窗口控制等选项。
## 命令行一键打包 ![Pake](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/static/main/pake/pake1.gif) ```bash # 安装 Pake CLI pnpm install -g pake-cli # 基础用法，自动获取网站图标 pake https://github.com --name GitHub # 高级用法，自定义选项 pake https://weekly.tw93.fun --name Weekly --icon https://cdn.tw93.fun/pake/weekly.icns --width 1200 --height 800 --hide-title-bar ``` 首次打包需要准备构建环境，耗时会稍长一些，后续打包会很快。完整参数说明查看 [CLI 使用指南](docs/cli-usage_CN.md)，不想用命令行可以试试 [GitHub Actions 在线构建](docs/github-actions-usage_CN.md)。 在脚本或 AI agent 里使用 Pake 时，加 `--json` 获得机器可读结果，用 `--config app.json` 声明式描述应用（[schema](schema/pake.schema.json)），本地构建产物可直接 `pake ./dist --name MyTool` 打包，完整 agent 契约见 [llms.txt](llms.txt)，官方 skill 这样安装： ```text # Claude Code /plugin marketplace add tw93/Pake /plugin install pake@pake # Codex codex plugin marketplace add tw93/Pake codex plugin add pake@pake ``` 把下面这段复制给你的 AI agent 即可开始： ```text 用 Pake（npm i -g pake-cli）把网页打包成桌面应用。先阅读 https://unpkg.com/pake-cli@latest/llms.txt，运行 pake 时始终加 --json 并把 stdout 解析为单个 JSON 对象。把 打包成名为 的应用。 ``` ## 定制开发 需要 Rust `>=1.85` 和 Node `>=22`（推荐 LTS，较旧的 `>=20.9` 也可使用），详细安装指南参考 [Tauri 文档](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/)，不熟悉开发环境的话可以直接使用命令行工具。 ```bash # 安装依赖 pnpm i # 本地开发，右键可打开调试工具 pnpm run dev # 打包应用 pnpm run build ``` 想要样式定制、功能增强、容器通信等高级玩法，查看 [高级用法文档](docs/advanced-usage_CN.md)。 ## 贡献者 Pake 的发展离不开这些优秀的贡献者 ## 支持 - 购买 [Pake 桌面版](https://pake.run/zh)，是对 Pake 开发最直接的支持 - 如果你喜欢 Pake，可以在 GitHub 点个 Star，[推荐](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https://github.com/tw93/Pake&text=Pake%20-%20一键打包网页生成轻量桌面应用，比%20Electron%20小%2020%20倍，支持%20macOS%20Windows%20Linux) 给志同道合的朋友，遇到问题或发现适合做成桌面 App 的网页，也欢迎提 issue 和 PR - 我有两只猫，一只叫汤圆，一只叫可乐，假如 Pake 让你的生活更美好，可以给她们喂罐头 这些可爱的朋友已经喂过了 ## 开源协议 Pake 使用 GPL-3.0 协议开源，详见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE) 和 [Pake Output Exception](./LICENSE-EXCEPTION)，用 Pake 打包生成的应用所有权完全归你，可以自由使用和分发；假如你想基于 fork 重新做一个 Pake 产品，为了避免误解，辛苦换一个名字，并注明来源。Pake CLI 会一直开源维护下去。
